title: Machine learning selects a nine-lncRNA signature for nasopharyngeal cancer metastasis
summary: Nine lncRNAs were identified by microarray profiling and RT-qPCR validation, then selected with a machine-learning method in a training cohort of 177 patients. The signature separated high- and low-risk groups for distant metastasis-free survival in a Guangzhou internal cohort (n = 177) and a Guilin external cohort (n = 150), outperformed anatomy-based metrics, and correlated with immune activity confirmed by digital pathology.
ai_technology: Machine-learning feature selection of a nine-lncRNA prognostic signature

evidence.tested: Training cohort n = 177, internal validation n = 177, external validation n = 150, digital pathology check.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective cohorts; clinical benefit not shown; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning method selected the final lncRNA signature from RT-qPCR-validated candidates.
